description: This is a C# source file defining the implementation of the DistributedGrainDirectory class within the Orleans runtime. It manages grain directory operations such as lookup, registration, unregistration, and recovery, handling partitioning, view changes, and membership updates in a distributed cluster.

classes.name: DistributedGrainDirectory
classes.description: Implementation of the grain directory managing distributed grain location data, handling partitioning, view changes, and cluster membership updates.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address of a grain by its GrainId.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a GrainAddress in the directory asynchronously.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a GrainAddress from the directory asynchronously.

methods.name: Register (overload)
methods.description: Registers a GrainAddress with a specified previous address.

methods.name: RecoverRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Recovers registered activations within a specified range during cluster recovery.

methods.name: GetRegisteredActivations
methods.description: Gets all registered activations within a range, optionally validating.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the cluster membership view asynchronously.

methods.name: GetPrimaryForGrain
methods.description: Returns the primary silo address responsible for the specified GrainId.

methods.name: GetLocalRecord
methods.description: Gets the local grain address record if available.
